goal: Add the missing admin_halt writer: an AAL2-gated admin route plus a Business detail panel that apply the Halt latch to a location's current Send batch, reusing the owner arm's latch mechanics and recording the RepWorth operator in account_audit_log.
non_goals: No migration — every value this needs already exists in migrations 091 and 108.
No new halt_reason CHECK member and no widening of OwnerHaltReason: the write union stays 2 members, the read union HaltReason stays 5.
No resume, undo or un-halt surface — the Halt latch stays monotone.
No cross-account /admin/solicitation list page; the surface is scoped to one location.
No change to the owner-facing Requests panel copy — the admin_halt read side already ships.
Not implementing the other two Halt latch writers (send_window_elapsed, batch_expired) or the #630 releaser.
The admin surface never renders customer outreach subjects or bodies.
Not re-opening #858: closeBatchIfSettled already canonicalises its own batch id as of PR #868.
user_visible_behavior: An admin viewing /admin/businesses/[id] sees the location's current Send batch and its Batch state.
When that batch is haltable, the admin can stop it, supplying a required free-text note.
Stopping writes halt_reason='admin_halt' and halted_by = the acting admin's users.id, and cancels that batch's rendered and queued Outreach rows.
The owner's Requests panel then renders the already-shipped copy: 'RepWorth support stopped this batch. It cannot be resumed — get in touch if that was not expected.'
An admin who has not stepped up to AAL2 is refused with 403 mfa_required and nothing is written.
A second stop on the same batch is a no-op reported as already_halted, with no second audit row.
A batch that is already closed is refused as not_haltable; the panel shows no stop control for it.
invariants: The Halt latch is monotone: the CAS on halted_at IS NULL means a second halt writes nothing.
Outreach rows in 'sending' are NEVER cancelled — halt means 'no further sends', not 'undo'. Only 'rendered' and 'queued' are cancelled.
The latch never terminalizes the Send batch parent directly; it calls closeBatchIfSettled like every other terminal writer, so parent terminalization keeps one owner.
halt_reason is fixed by the route's identity. No request field can name it, in either arm.
OwnerHaltReason stays exactly {'owner_veto','owner_halt'}; the admin arm cannot spell an owner reason and the owner arm cannot spell admin_halt.
writeAccountAuditLog runs in the SAME transaction as the latch write (CLAUDE.md 'Audit writes'); never a raw INSERT INTO account_audit_log.
Lock order stays advisory batch lock -> solicitation_batches row -> agent_runs: every run-spine call (recordStep, closeBatchIfSettled) happens LAST.
Invariant #15: src/lib/solicitation/approval.ts receives its DB client as an explicit parameter and never imports @/lib/db/server.
Invariant #12: the admin route parses, gates and maps errors only — the latch write lives in the domain module.
Invariant #8: the admin route proves tenancy with body-supplied accountId + businessId; a mismatched triple is the uniform 404, indistinguishable from an unknown batch.
The admin arm is NOT gated on SOLICITATION_SEND_ENABLED: support must be able to stop a stranded batch after the lane flag is turned off. The flag is a lane switch, not an authorization.
edge_cases: Mixed-case batch id from the request: canonicalised at the shared latch entry point (canonicalBatchId); closeBatchIfSettled also canonicalises since #868.
Batch already halted -> already_halted, no second latch write, no second audit row, no second spine step.
Batch already closed -> not_haltable with the derived Batch state.
Parentless batch (all-withheld, generation never minted a Send batch parent) -> still latches, skips the spine step, still calls closeBatchIfSettled.
Real batch id under the wrong accountId or businessId -> not_found (404), same as an unknown id.
Admin authenticated but AAL1 -> 403 mfa_required, no write.
Caller with a non-admin role -> 401/403 from requireRole before anything else runs.
Batch in 'sending' with rows mid-flight -> those 'sending' rows survive; only 'rendered'/'queued' cancel.
Missing, empty or over-long note -> 400 invalid_request, no write.
Cross-origin POST -> refused by withSameOrigin before the gate.
Location has no batch at all -> the panel renders the no-batch state and no stop control.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/app/api/admin/autonomy/unsuspend/route.ts — the AAL2 admin mutation route shape: requireAdminWithAal2, z.strictObject body, withSameOrigin export, internalError 500 mapping, required note.
src/lib/auto-approval/suspension.ts (unsuspendAccountAutonomy) — an admin users.id as the actor on a customer account, with writeAccountAuditLog in the same transaction.
src/lib/solicitation/approval.ts (haltBatch) — the latch body to extract: CAS on halted_at IS NULL, the rendered/queued cancel, the conditional recordStep, the closeBatchIfSettled join.
src/app/api/dashboard/solicitation/batch/halt/route.ts — the explicit toWire whitelist: no internal run id or spine vocabulary reaches the browser.
src/app/admin/businesses/[id]/_components/PastDueExtensionPanel.tsx — the admin mutation panel precedent on this page.
src/app/admin/businesses/[id]/page.tsx — server component reads SEQUENTIALLY (no Promise.all: the #773 fan-out) and passes initial data into BusinessDetailClient.
src/lib/solicitation/batch-view.ts — the send-lane read model; the admin projection belongs here, not in a new module.
tests_to_add: adminHaltBatch latches admin_halt and records the acting admin in halted_by
adminHaltBatch is monotone — a second halt writes nothing and adds no second audit row
adminHaltBatch never cancels an outreach row in sending
adminHaltBatch cancels rendered and queued outreach rows with disposition_reason admin_halt
adminHaltBatch writes account_audit_log in the same transaction as the latch write
adminHaltBatch halts a batch addressed by a mixed-case id and closes its send parent
adminHaltBatch returns not_found for a real batch id under the wrong tenant
adminHaltBatch latches a parentless batch without recording a spine step
adminHaltBatch returns not_haltable for a closed batch
haltBatch still derives owner_veto and owner_halt after the latch extraction
the admin halt route refuses a caller without AAL2 step-up and writes nothing
the admin halt route ignores a client-supplied halt reason — the reason comes from the route identity
the admin halt route rejects a body with a missing or empty note
the admin halt route returns 404 for a batch id under a mismatched tenant triple
the admin halt panel shows no stop control for a batch that is already halted
invariants: the admin arm always writes admin_halt and the owner arm never can, for every batch state
rollback_plan: Revert the PR. There is no migration to undo and no feature flag to flip — admin_halt is already a permitted CHECK member, so reverting simply removes the only writer and returns the value to unreachable. Any admin_halt rows already written stay valid and keep rendering the shipped owner copy; the Halt latch is monotone, so nothing needs unwinding. No staging or prod schema action at promotion.
observability: One account_audit_log row per successful halt: event_type='solicitation_batch_admin_halted', actor_user_id = the admin, entity_type='solicitation_batch', entity_id = the batch id, payload carrying the note, the derived Batch state at halt and the cancelled count. This is the durable 'a RepWorth operator did this' record.
One agent_run_steps row with step_key='batch_halted' and detail.halt_reason='admin_halt' on the Send batch parent — the batch-side story, absent only for a parentless batch.
A structured route log line naming status, batchId, businessId and cancelledCount — ids and counts only, never rendered subject or body.
Failures surface through internalError() as a 500 with a structured console.error, which reaches Sentry.
How I would know it broke: an admin_halt batch with no matching account_audit_log row, or a solicitation_outreach row still in 'rendered'/'queued' on a batch whose halted_at is set.
